Messages.Author: Joscha
Messages.Body:
Why going Anarch? What do I miss?

Changing the Wider Views to Anarch Revolts? Going anarch costs two blood and makes the minion even more vulnerable to the Shatterings.
Young Bloods would fit in well.
Why 4 Blood Dolls and 4 Vessels? Do you want to give blood to the minions to do the tricks? Maybe more Perfectionists would do the job better. Do you want to get pool by hunting? Than these are too many on 80 and you can find other masters to gain pool. And your minions need the blood on them anyway.
The rest seems fine and I like it much. Rock on.

Baron of Frankfurt

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body: Playing Amadeo with no Restricted vitae? That's wrong.

Messages.Author: Adonai
Messages.Body:
During the initial thoughts of the deck, Undue Influence would be used to bring in more of the minions. The crypt thinning of the Anarch Converts was kept, even after that thought was dropped (since Amadeo is a primogen).

Amadeo hunts for 3 with Perfectionist, and with enough Vessels and Blood Dolls on him you can save his hunt for your last action and then gain 3 pool on your next turn. If your predator is doing more than 3 pool damage to you per turn, you know where to send those Shattering Crescendos. Amadeo could certainly use an Aaron's Feeding Razor as well, but actions are at a premium, his actions in particular.
